statement: The windway exit gap as drawn for the printer is at least 1.2 mm
rationale: The printing notes: draw the gap 1.2 to 1.5 mm and never below about 1.0 mm, because a slot between two perimeter walls closes up by 0.1 to 0.3 mm and 1.0 mm is barely over two line widths; a printed whistle head with a 1.3 mm windway is the working example there (input fdm-whistle-printing-notes, section 2.1). 1.2 mm is the low end of that range, applied to the gap as drawn for the printer. That the printed slot is clear is C24.

mechanism.how: The windway exit gap as drawn for the printer (the acoustic gap plus the slot compensation), read from the model.
